    o.als_car_loan_sum_typ_allnum_rte,
    o.als_car_loan_orgnum,
    o.als_car_loan_allnum

        SELECT
            s.${s_topic_field},
            s.${s_mdl_dte_field},
            f.updated_at,
            f.uid,
            f.swift_number,
            f.sum_typ_orgnum,
            f.sum_typ_allnum,
            f.rcd_tim,
            f.flag_applyloanstr,
            f.ds,
            f.data_id,
            f.created_at,
            f.code,
            f.als_petty_loan_sum_typ_orgnum_rte,
            f.als_petty_loan_sum_typ_allnum_rte,

            f.als_petty_loan_allnum,
            f.als_other_sum_typ_orgnum_rte,
            f.als_other_sum_typ_allnum_rte,

            f.als_old_bank_sum_typ_orgnum_rte,
            f.als_old_bank_sum_typ_allnum_rte,
            f.als_net_bank_sum_typ_orgnum_rte,
            f.als_net_bank_sum_typ_allnum_rte,
            f.als_licensed_net_loan_sum_typ_orgnum_rte,
            f.als_licensed_net_loan_sum_typ_allnum_rte,
            f.als_least_id_rel_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_pdl_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_oth_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_nbank_week_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_nbank_sloan_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_nbank_p2p_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_nbank_oth_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_nbank_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_nbank_nsloan_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_nbank_night_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_nbank_mc_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_nbank_finlea_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_nbank_else_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_nbank_cons_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_nbank_com_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_nbank_cf_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_nbank_ca_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_nbank_autofin_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_coon_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_cooff_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_caon_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_caoff_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_bank_week_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_bank_tra_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_bank_ret_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_bank_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_bank_night_orgnum,
            f.als_least_id_af_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_rel_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_pdl_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_oth_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_nbank_week_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_nbank_sloan_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_nbank_p2p_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_nbank_oth_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_nbank_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_nbank_nsloan_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_nbank_night_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_nbank_mc_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_nbank_finlea_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_nbank_else_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_nbank_cons_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_nbank_com_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_nbank_cf_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_nbank_ca_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_nbank_autofin_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_coon_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_cooff_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_caon_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_caoff_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_bank_week_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_bank_tra_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_bank_ret_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_bank_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_bank_night_orgnum,
            f.als_greast_id_af_orgnum,
            f.als_credit_card_sum_typ_orgnum_rte,
            f.als_credit_card_sum_typ_allnum_rte,
            f.als_consume_stage_sum_typ_orgnum_rte,
            f.als_consume_stage_sum_typ_allnum_rte,
            f.als_consume_loan_sum_typ_orgnum_rte,
            f.als_consume_loan_sum_typ_allnum_rte,
            f.als_cash_stage_sum_typ_orgnum_rte,
            f.als_cash_stage_sum_typ_allnum_rte,
            f.als_car_loan_sum_typ_orgnum_rte,
            f.als_car_loan_sum_typ_allnum_rte,
            f.als_car_loan_orgnum,
            f.als_car_loan_allnum,
        dense_rank() over(partition by s.${s_topic_field} order by f.ds desc) as rn
        FROM  ${sample_table} s
        LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT *
                    FROM
                        pdm_risk.pdm_risk_dz_daily_br_trend_feature_v2
                    WHERE
                        datediff(to_date(ds ,'yyyyMMdd'), date_sub(to_date(${min_ds} ,'yyyyMMdd') ,${back_days})) >= 0
                    AND
                        ds <= ${max_ds}
                    ) f
        ON
            s.${s_topic_field}  = f.uid
        AND
        --- 数据回溯时，选择包含当天时，datediff 值大于等于0；否则仅大于0
            datediff(to_date(s.${s_mdl_dte_field}),to_date(f.ds ,'yyyyMMdd')) >= 0
        AND
            datediff(date_sub(to_date(s.${s_mdl_dte_field}),${back_days}),to_date(f.ds ,'yyyyMMdd')) <= 0
    ) o  WHERE rn = 1;
